About UHDT#

Founded in 2014, the University of Hawaiʻi Drone Technologies is a Vertically Integrated Project (VIP) at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa. The team aims to explore the applications of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) for the detection and geolocation of unexploded ordnances (UXOs) in Hawaiʻi. UHDT builds upon the efforts of the team’s previous work on package delivery, intelligence gathering, and search-and-rescue operations to complete their mission.
